payload.title: How to fix React useState TypeError?
payload.body_md:
I'm getting `TypeError: Cannot read property 'useState'` when using hooks in my React functional component. ## Code ```typescript import React from 'react'; function App() { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); // Error here return
{count}
; } ``` ## Error Message ``` TypeError: Cannot read property 'useState' of undefined at App.tsx:15:22 ``` ## Environment - React: 18.2.0 - TypeScript: 5.0.0 - Node: 20.10.0
